topic: Splitting every group dinner evenly vs paying your share and picking the spot (Homer vs Felicity)

scenes.narration: Splitting the check evenly costs the light eater hundreds a year. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a restaurant check split into equal slices with one tiny meal on the side, comic burst banner reads YOUR SHARE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Homer and Felicity both join the same friend group for dinners.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man homer and woman felicity at a long restaurant table with friends, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Homer orders a salad and water and never speaks up.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man homer with a small salad and a water glass, friends with steaks and cocktails around him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The table splits evenly. His salad costs sixty five dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt split into equal slices, man homer paying SIXTY FIVE for a salad, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Twice a month, that is over a thousand dollars a year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a treadmill display reading ONE THOUSAND FORTY, man homer sweating, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He starts skipping dinners and losing touch with friends.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man homer at home alone looking at group photos on a phone, a sad face, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Felicity says early, I will cover my own order plus tip.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman felicity smiling and raising a hand, speech banner reads I WILL PAY FOR MINE PLUS TIP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nobody minds. Most of the table quietly agrees.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, friends nodding around the table, thought bubbles reading ME TOO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She also suggests the spot sometimes, picking a place with a cheaper menu.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman felicity holding a phone showing a taco place menu, friends giving thumbs up, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She pays twenty two dollars and keeps six hundred a year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt reading TWENTY TWO, woman felicity laughing with friends, a scoreboard reads SIX HUNDRED SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Homer lost a thousand and his friends. Felicity kept both.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man homer alone with a bill, woman felicity at a crowded happy table, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Pay your share. Pick the spot. Keep your friends. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading PAY YOUR SHARE, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
